items.statement: The submission defines a reproducible candidate search and retains candidate identity through advancement and exclusion.
items.expected: Search/validation records identify explored pair orientations and a declared stopping rule.

items.statement: The selected optimized structure is validated as a stationary minimum and monomer/dimer thermochemistry uses a consistent convention.
items.expected: Frequency or justified alternative evidence supports a minimum and the three energy terms are traceable.

items.statement: The methyl-capped IIPO-oIPP pair has an attractive gas-phase interaction enthalpy.
items.expected: Reported ΔH is approximately −10.675 kcal/mol (−44.66 kJ/mol), subject to a fair method/conformer tolerance.

items.statement: The selected pair is interpreted within the paper's geometry boundary rather than as a direct duplex prediction.
items.expected: Report includes cap-carbon distance/planarity and explicitly limits interpretation to the methyl-capped gas-phase model.
